# Migration Requirements Checklist: OpenAI Model Migration

**Purpose**: Validate whether the requirements for moving the agent to OpenAI GPT-6 Luna are complete, clear, consistent, and review-ready before implementation and PR approval.
**Created**: 2026-11-15
**Feature**: `specs/005-model-migration/spec.md`

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for both settings the feature introduces or changes (the model and the reasoning effort), including what each means when unset? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the permissions the new model needs specified as requirements, or only as "every permission the configured model needs"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for which files and documents must stop naming the previous model? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK004 Is there a requirement covering agents already created from the template before it is updated? [Gap, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the prerequisites outside the project (model access, allowed regions) stated as requirements with a named owner, or only as assumptions? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "the records MUST show which of the two it was" specific about which record, and whether a separate failure entry satisfies it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "the same ... permissions behaviour and documentation as this agent" precise enough to compare a new project against, with the allowed differences stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Spec §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "the model's own default" defined for the case where the owner later changes to a model with a different default or no reasoning at all? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the allowed reasoning effort levels listed in the requirements, or only in the plan? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Gap]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Does FR-006 (no permission for any other model) agree with the plan's added permission on the account's default project, which is not a model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Plan research Decision 3]
- [ ] CHK012 Does FR-003 (request records must not change) agree with FR-008 (records must show which prerequisite failed)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK013 Is User Story 5's priority (P3) consistent with FR-002 treating "back to the previous model" as a firm requirement? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 5, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK014 Do the Background, the Clarifications and the Assumptions agree on whether the region restriction is lifted or only reported as lifted? [Consistency, Spec §Background, Spec §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Can SC-002 be measured as written, with the validation steps of features 001 and 002 that "can be run against a deployed agent" identified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK017 Is SC-004's 30-second limit a decision by the owner or a placeholder, and does the spec say which? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK018 Does SC-010 define a fair comparison, given that replies to the same prompt vary from run to run? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK019 Is there a success criterion for FR-009 (a conversation from before the migration must not cause a failure)? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK020 Is "done" unambiguous now that answer quality is reported and not a pass mark, including who records the result and where? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003, Spec §Clarifications]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for the period between deploying this change and the prerequisites being met, when every request fails? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for a reasoning effort value the configured model rejects? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for the account's usage limit being reached sooner because output counts tenfold? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for branch deployments that still carry the previous model in their settings? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Are rollback requirements complete for the case where the previous model is still unavailable to the account? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 5, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 Is there a requirement or stated expectation for cost per request, given that cost was the owner's first priority in choosing the model? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK027 Are data-handling requirements for the new model's provider stated, or only assumed acceptable? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Is least privilege stated as a requirement for any permission added beyond the model itself? [Security, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-006]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK029 Is the assumption that the current agent code can call the new model without changes recorded as something the plan must confirm, and has the plan said how? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan research Decision 1]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the dependency on the template repository stated with what "updated" means for it and how that is verified without creating a real project? [Dependency, Spec §FR-015, Spec §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the risk of making an unproven model the default for every new project acknowledged in the requirements? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
